card.name: Inside "interstitial" lung findings
card.fires_on: The piece "stitial" completing "interstitial" in descriptions of lung findings such as infiltrates on a chest X-ray. It also fires weakly on "pathologic" in similar radiology phrases.

card.plain: It marks the end of the word "interstitial" in chest X-ray findings, where "changes" or "infiltrates" tends to come next.
